title: Harbor suite.toml task entry
description: Reference contract for one [[tasks]] entry in a dataset's suite.toml. The id is the full Harbor task name (jacobian/<dataset-id>-<short-name>), the path is relative to the suite root and may nest arbitrarily deep, assurance_ceiling caps the claimed_assurance the verifier will accept, and required_provider names the optional backend the task depends on (or null for core-only tasks).
